name: firm-brain
description: The FIRM BRAIN service (W054) — the pure composition service over the memory contract: foundBrain(scope) + ingest(brain, records) — THE INGESTION GATES: every knowledge record re-proven through its source package's own validators (W053 post-mortems/lessons, W040 capabilities, W051 search histories — errors carried VERBATIM), the record's scope proven ISOLATED to the brain's tenant (R056 named loudly on violation), then the new brain generation sealed (append-only lineage extended, never rewritten) — and the DETERMINISTIC RECALL surface (by-kind/by-source/by-citation queries over canonically ordered, carried results; cross-tenant query parameters refused loudly naming R056). A14: composes typed records — never reasons, never decides, never improves autonomously (W055), no security (W060).
